note: Charged-current single-pion production off deuterium at the ANL 12-ft bubble chamber (Radecky et al., Phys. Rev. D 25, 1161 (1982)). Absolute cross sections for the three exclusive CC 1-pion channels with the hadronic-invariant-mass cut W < 1.4 GeV: total cross section sigma(E_nu) for nu_mu p -> mu- p pi+, nu_mu n -> mu- n pi+, and nu_mu n -> mu- p pi0, plus the flux-integrated dsigma/dQ^2 for the dominant Delta++ channel nu_mu p -> mu- p pi+ (W < 1.4 GeV). These are the published Radecky cross-section tables shipped by NUISANCE (the anl82 '14Wcut' sigma files and the 1982 dSigdQ2 file); the accompanying noEvents/weighted files in the same NUISANCE directories are event-count histograms and are excluded. Target: bound nucleon in deuterium.
provenance: Radecky:1981fn - ANL 12-ft CC single-pion production on deuterium; total cross sections sigma(E_nu) for the three exclusive channels (mu- p pi+, mu- n pi+, mu- p pi0) with W < 1.4 GeV, plus dsigma/dQ^2 for nu_mu p -> mu- p pi+ - from the NUISANCE data release
